description: Answer 'what should I use to do X' in one call. Given a plain-language task (and optional platform/category), returns the best-match HeyClaude entries ranked by fit — each with why it fits, trust summary, disclosed safety/privacy notes, and an inline install block — plus a topPick and a consolidated installPlan. Unlike workflow.plan it does not force category diversity; it returns the genuinely best matches. Collapses the search → compare → detail → asset loop into a single answer-shaped response.

category.description: Restrict recommendations to a single category.

platform.description: Restrict to entries compatible with this platform.

task.description: Plain-language description of what you want to accomplish, e.g. 'review pull requests in Claude Code' or 'connect to a Postgres database'.

name: registry.recommend
